individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A consists only of fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge); it contains no plotted/quantified data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel A is a set of micrographs, not a plot, so this check does not apply.

individual-data-points.explanation: The JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity bar charts (n=20) show only mean +/- error bar, without individual data points overlaid.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars appear on both bar charts but the caption/figure text only gives sample size and p-value thresholds (n=20, *p<0.05, **p<0.01) without stating what the error bars represent (e.g., SD or SEM).

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel C is a Western blot image, not a plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel C is a blot, not a plot, so this check does not apply.

individual-data-points.explanation: The SDH and COX signal intensity bar charts show group means with error bars and sample sizes labelled in the bars, but no individual data points are overlaid.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars appear on the SDH/COX signal intensity bar charts but neither the caption nor the on-figure text (which only notes the statistical test, ##: p<0.01, Tukey's test follows One-way ANOVA) defines what the error bars represent.

individual-data-points.explanation: The FACS panels are histograms (cell count vs TMRM intensity distributions) showing the full raw distribution of cells rather than a summary of averages, so individual data points are not required.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The FACS histograms display raw count distributions with no error bars, so no definition is required.
